decision.observation: The loudspeaker displays “NEXT!”, but the third entrant has not arrived. The newspaper compartment has slid out and covered the stamps.
decision.hypothesis: Clicking the right-edge compartment tab will close it and restore access to the stamps while the entrant approaches.
decision.memory: Day 2 on 1982.11.24: first entrant approved with a valid REPUBLIA passport; second denied for an ANTEGRIA passport expired 1982.11.16. Passports are required, documents must be current, foreigners may enter, and inconsistencies must be denied.
